bbox_source: largest connected component of the luminance < 245 mask (0.9994 of all sub-threshold pixels). The raw bbox of that mask, used by jee.core.calculate_calibration, is [123, 2, 1888, 2272] -- the whole image -- because 949 background pixels in 533 disconnected speckles (luminance 212-244) span [123, 2, 1888, 2272].
